note: Machine-readable style rules shared by every character of this style (inspection A4). verify_candidate.gd prints the prompt SIZE CONTRACT from these numbers and gates generated candidates; the importers refuse candidates that fail.

materials.skinNote: Palette indices counted as face skin. Derived with verify_candidate.gd --derive, then reviewed. Very light hair could be counted as skin; the face check only looks at the lower 55% of the head.

head.why: The head is a shared module: native hats are drawn and anchored for the native skull, and RO identity depends on the large rounded face. Head size is a template rule, not a per-character choice (user review 2026-09-25).

body.why: Costumes may change the silhouette a little, but hands, feet and neck must stay where the native ACT expects them.

head:1.derivedBy: verify_candidate.gd --derive (largest skin component in the lower 55% of the native head)

designRules: Mirrored views flip asymmetric details (inspection B7): a hip pouch changes sides between S and E. Design costumes to tolerate the flip, or keep key details symmetric.
Raw SPR head and body slots face LEFT; the game mirrors them. Prompts must follow the slot's facing, not the design reference's.
